## E0 bring-up — start (2026-07-15)

Live prototype of hermes-on-Apple-`container`, executing the 5-experiment matrix from spike memo note 452679f under backlog task 89dbaae. User approved the host install; constraints: E1∥E2 parallel, NO host reboot / NO logout-login (machine in active use — cold-boot recovery leg assessed analytically, live proof deferred), soak 24h extend-on-drift, iterate-to-definitive + standing upstream watch.

**Host**: M4 Max / 128 GB / macOS 26.4.1 (25E253). Nested virt HW-capable (not needed for the plan).

**Pre-install network survey** (the collision the plan guards against, confirmed live):
- `bridge100` = 192.168.64.1/24 is the live tart fleet bridge; VMs at .11/.26/.27 (metal/hermes/bluebubbles), vmenet0/1/2 attached. This is the subnet `container` grabs by default as an unprivileged user (apple/container disc #1003).
- **192.168.72.0/24 absent from routes + ifaces** → chosen as the container subnet override, written to `~/.config/container/config.toml` BEFORE first `container system start`.
- InternetSharing RUNNING (vmnet NAT engine — never touch).

**Bring-up artifacts**:
- container **1.1.0** signed pkg (`container-1.1.0-installer-signed.pkg`, published 2026-07-06T19:47:13Z). sha256 `0ca1c42a2269c2557efb1d82b1b38ac553e6a3a3da1b1179c439bcee1e7d6714`. Verified: notarized, `Developer ID Installer: Apple Inc. - Containerization (UPBK2H6LZM)`, trusted timestamp 2026-07-06 19:58:46Z. spctl: accepted / Notarized Developer ID.
- socktainer **v1.1.1** (published 2026-07-14T17:49:31Z) — matches recon; installs via brew.
- Scratch root `~/.yclaw/spike-container/` (pkg/state/artifacts/proxy/bin) — verified OUTSIDE `~/.yclaw/state` (restic scope) and outside the repo tree.

Next: USER runs `sudo installer -pkg ... -target /` (Background session can't sudo); agent writes config.toml subnet override; `container system start`; guardrail battery.
